The '''75th Legion forward camp''', originally the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] '''Lytle Research Outpost''', was located in the [[Shattered Pipeworks]] area of the [[Tularan Marsh]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and served as a base of operations for the [[75th Legion]].
